name: checkout
title: Checkout
summary: Turns a cart (or a Buy now offer) into an accepted order: identify the customer or guest, choose an address with a per-item shippability check, pick delivery options per package, apply coupons or credit with reasons and item coverage, choose payment, review sellers, return terms and totals, revalidate into a change set the customer must accept, and place the order idempotently with clear payment results.
owns: Checkout sessions (the quote): source cart or Buy now, lines, packages, selections, totals and quote version
Customer or guest identification (guest email and phone, optional account after checkout)
Delivery address selection and the per-item shippability check
Delivery options per package with separate arrival estimates
Coupons and store credit in the quote: applied amounts, which items each discount covers, rejection reasons
Payment method selection for the quote
Full review: seller, return terms and seller support per package, purchase terms, totals per package and for the order, tax

Revalidation before charging: change sets (price, stock, delivery date, delivery option, coupon, shippability) with per-change choices, alternatives from other sellers shown explicitly, and partial-order consent
Idempotent Place order: one order and one charge per checkout whatever the number of taps, refreshes or retries
Payment results: accepted (confirmation), failed (retry or another method, cart kept, stock held for a window), pending check (no second payment, order status)
notOwns: Cart contents and change detection between visits: cart
The order record, items and documents: orders
Authorization, capture, payment status checks and saved methods: payments
Delivery options and arrival estimates: shipping
Coupon rules, budgets and redemption: promotions; store credit balances: wallet (phase 3)
Stock holds: inventory; saved addresses and address validation: customers

stateMachines.name: Checkout session
stateMachines.notes: placing is held under a row lock; a second Place order (any key) while placing, payment_pending or completed returns the current result instead of a new attempt. payment_failed keeps lines, delivery choices, coupons, the stock hold and the promotion reservation until holdUntil (retry window). After a pending payment is finally declined the order is cancelled by orders, the lines are restored to the cart and the session returns to payment_failed; a retry then creates a new order. expire releases holds and voids any authorization.

endpoints.summary: Start checkout from the cart or Buy now
endpoints.desc: Cart: eligible lines only (or the chosen cartItemIds); unavailable lines stay in the cart and are listed in excludedLines. Buy now: one offer and quantity, the cart is not touched, and the customer still sees totals and must press Place order. Account step is pre-filled for signed-in customers; customers.canPlaceOrders is checked.

endpoints.summary: The whole checkout: steps, contact, address, packages with options, coupons, payment, review and totals
Guest contact details (email, optional phone) and the account-after-checkout choice
Choose a saved address or enter one; checks every item can ship there
endpoints.desc: Validates with customers.validateAddress and shipping.checkCoverage per line; re-quotes delivery options and tax. Changing the address here never changes the address book unless saveToAddressBook is set.

endpoints.summary: Pick a delivery option for each package
Apply a coupon code
endpoints.desc: Always 200 with the result: applied (amount, funding, covered and not covered items) or rejected with the reason; other discounts are unchanged. Account coupons for guests return needs_sign_in.

endpoints.summary: Remove a coupon
Use store credit for part or all of the total
Choose a saved card, a new card (provider token) or a digital wallet
Gift note and hide prices on packing slips
Check price, stock, delivery, coupons and shippability again
endpoints.desc: Also run automatically when the review step opens and inside Place order. Changes produce a change set; nothing is charged.

endpoints.summary: The changes found, with choices, alternatives and the revised total
Apply the customer's choice for every change and continue
endpoints.desc: Every change needs a decision. choose_offer must name a listed alternative (the only way the seller changes). When items are removed or unavailable, acceptPartialOrder must be true. Returns the revised checkout with a new quote version to review before Place order.

endpoints.summary: Place the order and pay
endpoints.desc: Requires an Idempotency-Key; the same key returns the first result, and while a session is placing, pending or completed any further call returns the current result without a new charge. Steps: lock; check quoteVersion and expectedTotal; revalidate (changes → changes_required, nothing charged); hold stock (inventory.hold); reserve promotions; read content.currentPolicyVersions(['returns', 'shipping', 'purchase_terms']) (the versions accepted with this order); authorize (payments.authorize); then accepted → order created and accepted (confirmation); pending → order created with payment checking (payment-result page, no second payment); failed → no order, cart and choices kept, holds kept until retryUntil; requires_action → bank challenge.

endpoints.summary: Finish Place order after a bank challenge or wallet confirmation
Pay again with the same or another method after a decline
endpoints.desc: Only from payment_failed within the retry window. Revalidates first (changes are shown before paying). Creates a new payment attempt; never reuses a declined authorization.

endpoints.summary: Order confirmation (only after the payment is accepted)
endpoints.desc: Order reference, charged total and method, delivery address, packages with their own estimates, next steps and receipt link. Returns ILLEGAL_TRANSITION while the payment is pending or failed.

endpoints.summary: Leave checkout (releases holds, voids any authorization)
Checkouts with payment problems or open changes (support view)

notes: Dependencies: architecture lists cart, orders, payments, shipping and customers. offers (revalidate, snapshots, alternatives) and inventory (stock holds) are added because Place order calls them directly; both are already required by cart, so this adds no new load-time constraint. Optional: promotions (coupons, markdown allocation), wallet (credit, phase 3), returns (resolveTerms for return terms per package), content (purchase terms version), identity (guest order access grant).

Steps (plan ch. 6): 1 account or guest (email required, phone optional, create account later), 2 address with shippability per item, 3 delivery option per package with separate arrival dates, 4 coupons and credit with item coverage and rejection reasons, 5 payment method and full review (seller, return terms, seller support per package, purchase terms), 6 Place order and payment result. Confirmation is only shown when the payment is accepted.

Quote version: any change to lines, address, options, coupons, credit, tax or prices increments quoteVersion. Place order compares quoteVersion and expectedTotal with the current quote, so the customer is never charged a total they did not see.

Revalidation sources: offers.revalidate (price, availability, terms version, seller restriction; never substitutes a seller), inventory.getAvailability, shipping.quoteOptions for the selected options (date moved, option gone, shipping cost), shipping.checkCoverage, promotions.evaluateCart (coupon ended or changed, budget, limits), tax. Each difference becomes one Change with choices; alternatives come from offers for the same variant and are applied only when chosen.
Partial orders: removing items or unavailable items leaves a smaller order; acceptChanges requires acceptPartialOrder=true and the review step shows the revised packages and total before Place order.

Idempotency (scenario 3): place_requests stores each Idempotency-Key with a hash of the body; the same key and body return the stored result (refreshed with the current status), a different body returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. The session lock and status guard mean even a new key cannot start a second order or charge while placing, pending or completed. payments.authorize uses sessionId + attempt number as its key.

Accepted path: payments.authorize → orders.createOrder (order created and accepted; dispatch deadlines from the selected options; policyVersions from content.currentPolicyVersions read at placement) → payments.linkOrder → inventory.attachOrder → promotions.commitRedemption → cart.removePurchasedItems (other cart lines stay) → identity grants the guest session access to the order → confirmation.

Failed path: no order; status payment_failed; the decline reason and retry choices are shown; lines, delivery choices, coupons, the stock hold and the promotion reservation are kept until holdUntil; the customer can retry with the same card, another card or a wallet, or go back to checkout.

Pending path: the order is created with payment checking and its reference is shown; the customer is told not to pay again and is directed to the order status; payments' check job resolves it, and the session completes or returns to payment_failed (lines restored to the cart).
Buy now creates a session from one offer; it never changes the cart and still requires the review and Place order steps (plan ch. 5).
Per-customer purchase limits count units in this checkout plus orders.countPurchased within purchaseLimitWindowDays.
